## About
N B Exxon is a family owned and operated business. We started out as a gas station and full service auto repair shop, mostly doing maintenance. Later we closed the gas station and opened up a full service auto repair and preventive maintenance facility.
Our motto is simple: taking the time to do each job right the first time. Customers know Sammy by name, and one reviewer said the owners are cool to just talk to while you wait for your work to be done.
We're rated 4.9 from 558 Google reviews. You'll find us behind Long John Silver and Apple Bees, next to Harbor Freight Tools.

## Services
- Oil Change: Regular oil changes to keep your car running right.
- Brake Job: Brake repair when your brakes need attention.
- Brake Flush: Fresh brake fluid for your braking system.
- Automatic Transmission service: Service for your automatic transmission.
- Coolant Flush: A coolant flush for your cooling system.
- State Inspection: Get your state inspection done here.
- 30/60/90 Mile Maintenance: Scheduled maintenance at the 30/60/90 mile marks.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We specialize in maintenance and repair on most vehicle makes and models.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept all major credit cards and the Exxon-Mobil Card.

Q: How do I find the shop?
A: We're on E Belt Line Rd in Richardson, behind Long John Silver and Apple Bees, next to Harbor Freight Tools.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday thru Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.
